Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2
Subject: General

Topic 1.2: Articulating letters of the alphabet.

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Articulating letters of the alphabet., part of LISTENING AND SPEAKING in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: Which letter sounds almost sound similar?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Articulating letters of the alphabet. together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
• Respect: The learner demonstrates patience while taking turns in articulating the letter sounds.

• Integrity: The learner demonstrates discipline while chanting rhymes on letter sounds with others in class.

Core competencies:

• Communication and collaboration: The learner correctly articulates letter sounds and as a team matches letter sounds with

corresponding object names beginning with the letter sound.

• Self-efficacy: The learner assertively chants rhymes on letter sounds in class.

Values:

• Respect: The learner demonstrates patience while taking turns in articulating the letter sounds.

• Integrity: The learner demonstrates discipline while chanting rhymes on letter sounds with others in class.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issue(
s) :

Effective communication: The learner correctly articulates letter sounds in preparation for reading of words.

Link to other Activity Areas:

Articulation of letter sounds links to all Activity Areas since effective pronunciation is important across the curriculum.
